Drop the 5 founder fixture photos into the paths below and flip their groups to enabled:true — no code changes needed. Group expectations: expect_all_excluded, expect_min_recs, expect_verdicts_include, expect_recency_question, expect_tenure_question, answers (posted after the report renders).
